title: Decision Record
description: Machine-readable Architecture Decision Record. Authors create this file (with decision-id, title, status, narrative) when starting a decisions/<client>/<version>/<decision-id> branch. The .github/workflows/decision-*.yml chain progressively writes the scope, discovery, referential-integrity, strategy-alignment, principles-alignment, proponent, and challenger sections.

decision-id.description: Unique identifier — must match the JSON file name and the trailing segment of the decision branch name

title.description: Short human-readable title of the decision

narrative.description: Author's narrative of the proposed change. Read by all downstream workflows.

scope.description: Output of the Scope Validation workflow

discovery.description: Output of the Decision Discovery workflow

referential-integrity.description: Output of the Referential Integrity workflow

strategy-alignment.description: Output of the Strategy Alignment workflow

principles-alignment.description: Output of the Principles Alignment workflow

proponent.description: Output of the Decision Proponent workflow

challenger.description: Output of the Decision Challenger workflow
